title: BUGFIX — Fix TS2339 type error: bundle.hook does not exist on ScriptBundle (blocks direct ts-node invocation)
rationale: agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts line 550 uses bundle?.hook?.text but ScriptBundle interface has no 'hook' field (it has hook_formula_used and the hook text is in segments). PM2 uses TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true so this is suppressed in production, but running 'npx ts-node agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts' directly fails with TS2339 — blocking local testing and all manual invocations. Fix: replace bundle?.hook?.text with bundle?.segments.find(s => s.segment_name === 'hook')?.voiceover_text.

tasks.description: Fix agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts line 550: change 'bundle?.hook?.text?.slice(0, 80) ?? "AI Content"' to 'bundle?.segments.find(s => s.segment_name === "hook")?.voiceover_text?.slice(0, 80) ?? "AI Content"'. This is Stage 9.5 ledger fallback entry title field.
